decision.topic: PR-10 scaffold-only and PR-11 walking-skeleton exit semantics
decision.note: The approved option fixes what PR-10 and PR-11 may prove at their exit. It does not schedule, unblock or authorize either item, and it is not the exit evidence itself.

gapBinding.reason: KGA-D05 is a decision-level exit-semantics question with no single structural gap row. It bounds the vacuous-readiness-green signal recorded as KGA-G06 by capping what PR-10 and PR-11 can prove, but the non-vacuous kernel code-start gate stays unbuilt and the gap stays open.

immutableRefs.note: Approval intake, EPOCH-03 chain, registry, gap inventory and the base execution queue are read by digest only; application state lives in the application-state ledger.

exitSemantics.evidenceRequirement: PR-10 exits only by proving that SDK public ports and the codegen guard compile and are shaped as declared. Because SDK ports precede data-plane completion, no PR-10 artifact may be read as SDK-ready, and real SDK readiness stays behind human runtime evidence.
exitSemantics.queueGapFinding: SDK ports precede data-plane completion and can prove scaffold only, not SDK-ready.

exitSemantics.evidenceRequirement: PR-11 exits only by proving a minimal API and UI boot smoke end to end. A booting skeleton is not app-buildable evidence, so no PR-11 artifact may be read as app-buildable, feature-complete or release-ready.
exitSemantics.queueGapFinding: API/UI boot smoke is a walking skeleton, not app-buildable evidence.

invariants: Recording an exit ceiling is a governance record, not exit evidence: PR-10 proves scaffold only and PR-11 proves a walking skeleton only, and both ceilings are bounds on what may be claimed, not readiness.
A ceiling never promotes readiness: no PR-10 artifact may be read as SDK-ready and no PR-11 artifact as app-buildable, kernel-ready or release-ready.
The base execution queue stays byte-identical read-only evidence: 37 items, base sequence PR-01..PR-11, nextActionable PR-01, and this record neither reorders nor applies it.
PR-10 stays blocked behind PR-09 and PR-11 behind PR-10; naming an exit ceiling unblocks, schedules and authorizes nothing.
The PR execution handoff and the PR-10/PR-11 agent packs stay source-evidence-only: they carry no canonical ownership and are never promoted to a normative DoD.
No runtime, scaffold, SDK or platform code is written, generated or scheduled by this record.
The registry keeps all ten decisions pending and unselected; the closure intake and EPOCH-03 chain are read by digest only.
No planning artifact here is runtime implementation evidence, a code-start permit or a readiness claim.
nonGoals: do not unblock, reorder, reschedule or renumber PR-10, PR-11 or any base queue item, and do not move nextActionable off PR-01
do not promote the PR execution handoff or the PR-10/PR-11 agent packs to a normative definition of done
do not write, generate or scaffold runtime, SDK, API or UI code, and do not treat a ceiling as the exit evidence that satisfies it
do not claim SDK-ready, app-buildable, kernel-ready, release or deploy from a scaffold or a walking skeleton
do not change any registry decision, the closure intake, the EPOCH-03 authority chain or any generated projection

rollback.trigger: an exit ceiling widens beyond scaffold-only or walking-skeleton-only, a ceiling is read as exit evidence or readiness, the base queue bytes, ordering, nextActionable or PR-10/PR-11 blocked status drift, a cited pack gains normative or canonical standing, or a fail-closed gate flag flips
rollback.action: revert this exit-semantics record, its application-state row, the attestation contract, tests, pack sections and gate wiring as one shard
